prompt_en: Create a product-led jewelry campaign photograph of one 28-year-old adult woman, using the attached portrait as the visual reference for her softly oval face, dark brown almond-shaped eyes, straight fine nose, full rose-colored lips, and long dark center-parted waves. She sits at a waist-high instrument table in an observatory instrument room at blue hour, wearing a charcoal sleeveless tailored top. Her left wrist wears a wide sculptural silver cuff with one raised oval green cabochon in a smooth bezel. The cuff is the visual hero: its continuous curved silver band, separate bezel rim, polished green dome, and open-ended construction are individually readable. Her left elbow stays bent close to her ribs while her left palm supports the underside of a shallow lightweight specimen tray, lifting it a few centimeters above the tabletop. Her right hand lightly steadies the tray's opposite rim; both connected forearms and all fingertips remain visible. The left wrist's outer surface turns toward the camera, placing the cuff above the tray rim with a clear skin-to-metal boundary. A small dark meteorite rests inside the tray. Her face inclines toward the stone with a calm, attentive expression. Frame a vertical waist-up three-quarter photograph with the cuff near the lower center and her face above it, giving the product enough image area to inspect its shape. A large neutral softbox with black flags draws clean broad highlights along the silver and a soft reflection across the stone while retaining its green body color. The cuff and eyes share crisp useful detail, with dark telescope hardware and a faint blue window softly resolved behind her. Visible pores, fine hair strands, credible finger joints, and restrained commercial retouching give the campaign a tangible photographic finish. Keep a narrow margin below both elbows so the lower frame reveals the full tray support. Shape the silver reflection into a long pale rectangle bounded by a darker edge, separating the cuff silhouette from her illuminated skin.
